messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning branch cut for release/1.12 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can owners confirm backport candidates and any outstanding cherry-picks? @sasha @dan
dan: I'll own release notes bump and the changelog. PRs I expect: #2894 (kv-cache fix), #2901 (batching tweak). Want backport for both.
sasha: can we avoid backporting the quantization refactor? it's risky. prefer a patch in 1.12.1.
maria: agreed. only cherry-picks for bugfixes that don't touch model weights or runtime kernels. ops: any infra constraints for tomorrow? @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: infra is green. maintenance window set 09:00-09:30 PT. release-bot will create release/* once owners ack.
jules: FYI I need backport for #2907 (routing fallback) — it's causing 503s in staging.
dan: ack for #2907. I'll open cherry-pick PRs after branch is created.
release-bot: scheduled action: will create branch release/1.12 at 1779930000. use `/release status` to check.
sasha: quick Q — backport policy: do we allow config-only changes without tests? e.g., cors header tweak in #2910.
maria: config-only ok if it's low-risk and has e2e or unit in the PR. If no tests, add `backport: hold` label and we can triage.
dan: tagging process: ping @eng-releases and add the label `backport/1.12` to the PR. I'll then review.
sasha: noted. I'll add the label to #2910 and include minimal test.
dan: Also: remind owners to run `git checkout -b release/1.12 origin/main` and `./scripts/make-changelog --since v1.11` after branch is cut. saves time.
maria: thanks. final checklist before cut:
- owners ack
- backport labels on PRs
- CI green on main
- changelog updated
If anyone needs help ping me. :rocket:
